cases.derivation: Under the default configuration every field carries ascending, descending and array-membership modes at collection scope, so an array contributes two ordered entries plus two membership entries for each distinct element and the ownership marker contributes two. The count therefore moves in steps of two: 19,998 distinct elements reach exactly 40,000 and 19,999 reach 40,002. A short document name keeps every entry small enough that the entry-sum maximum stays far away, so the count is the only limit that can explain the refusal. No composite index is declared or required.

cleanup.probedNames: The four names that exceed a request-stage identifier limit are never created and are not owned resources: the API does not consider them resources, so typed absence cannot be proven and the Gate cannot release them. If production unexpectedly accepts one, the Gate's creation-proof check refuses the proof, the campaign stops with its journal preserved, and the owned document is handed to the recovery owner for manual removal.
procedure: Read each owned resource and verify its ownership marker.
Bind the exact creation version recorded by the Gate before any delete.
Delete only owned resources with a matching updateTime precondition.
Read each owned resource and require typed NOT_FOUND.
On uncertain read, marker mismatch, binding drift or incomplete receipt, stop and preserve the journal.
cleanup.recovery: No unconditional delete; unresolved resources remain assigned to the recovery owner.

collectorBinding.differenceFromLimits02: Every mutating method is gated by the write-safety predicate, not PATCH alone, because this campaign sends its first writes over :batchWrite. The preflight prefix length is read from the plan. collector.py is byte-for-byte unchanged, so the frozen limits-02 collector source digest still resolves.
collectorBinding.scope: REST BatchWrite per-position outcome, create-only document writes, typed readbacks and request-stage name refusals, with ownership and version bound cleanup. No configuration, index, Rules or account operation.
collectorBinding.technicalBlocker: The limits production runner in tools/compat-broad/fs-write-limits/production.py is bound to the limits-02 compiler and does not yet accept this campaign. No frozen artifact, permission envelope or nonce reservation exists.

comparatorBinding.addition: A per-row structural field reports status, typed error code and status, the per-item BatchWrite codes and whether the document is present, with diagnostic wording removed. It is additive and never changes the classification. The duplicate-document control is expected to differ in wording, and this field keeps that from hiding the continuation answer.
comparatorBinding.contract: The limits-02 contract: both plans are regenerated from the compiler, every ordered request including its typed body is checked, a complete response journal is required, and normalized document identity and server timestamps may differ as EXPECTED_NONDETERMINISM while everything else, message text included, is significant.

configuration.indexes: Read-only. The campaign must not deploy or change an index, and it needs no addition to conformance/firestore.indexes.json: see indexConfiguration. Every created document is compiled to stay inside every limit it is not testing, so no refusal is confounded.
configuration.restoration: No configuration changes are permitted; drift stops the campaign.

overlapWith.resolution: No overlap. Limits-02 owns FS-LIMIT-DOCUMENT-BYTES and FS-LIMIT-NESTED-MAP-ARRAY-DEPTH and has executed; this campaign owns the BatchWrite continuation residue and the three configuration-independent identifier limits.

indexConfiguration.derivation: Every index boundary in this campaign is reached under the project's default single-field configuration, in which each field carries ascending, descending and array-membership modes at collection scope. The entry-bytes boundary is tuned with the document and parent name bytes, the entry-count boundary with the number of distinct array elements, and the entry-sum boundary with both. No composite index and no field override is declared, so conformance/firestore.indexes.json needs no addition and its preflight digest does not change.

pendingLocalImplementation.meaning: These rows state the documented production behaviour for a limit the catalog still records as unsupported. A local difference on one of them is evidence about the local runtime, not a campaign failure, and it is recorded rather than discarded.
